coverage.scope: scientific unit tests plus run_all; package-integrity tests excluded from this engineering metric
coverage.interpretation: Engineering health metric only; not evidence for the arbitrary-set theorems.

input_validation_repairs: message counts must be positive non-boolean integers
list budgets and vertex counts must be nonnegative non-boolean integers
vertex indices are range-checked before pruning
missing witness values are distinguished from legal None-valued programs
explicit empty decoders are rejected rather than replaced by defaults
nonempty program/support universes are required by capacity interfaces
missing required source rows are rejected rather than synthesized as empty rows
explicit empty rows remain valid infeasible constraints and are distinguished from missing rows
directed preservation and access relations require complete source-row domains
